primary.runtime: Set by theme.js applyPalette from the user's background/colour/saturation/brightness; value here is the default.

secondary.note: Lifted by legibleAccent before use as tint or glyph.

display.purpose: Lowercase greeting only; nowrap, hard-clipped by container. Phone: clamp(3.6rem, 18vw, 5rem).

numeral.purpose: Absence total and today's date on live tiles.

headline.purpose: Next-class course name, single line with ellipsis.

title.purpose: Section headings: large, light, left-aligned, no kicker.

door-title.purpose: Module and shortcut names; 19px on phones.

body.purpose: Greeting subtitle and Hitokoto quote, max 62ch.

mono.purpose: Collapsed raw error pre and error codes only.

materials.name: glass-pane
materials.value: border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge); border-radius: var(--tile-radius); background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%)
materials.purpose: Every tile and panel. One tint, one hairline, no sheen.

materials.name: door-tint
materials.purpose: USER-PINNED per-module door tint; accent = legibleAccent(palette[[0,1,2,3,1][i]]).

materials.name: flood
materials.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 78%, rgba(18,15,22,.6)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 70%, transparent)
materials.purpose: Next-class tile when a class is now or later today.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: All tiles, doors, panels, schedule blocks.

motion.name: tilt-ease
motion.purpose: Press-tilt release (320ms), flip (620ms), door arrow nudge (260ms).

motion.name: press-tilt
motion.value: perspective(700px) rotateX/rotateY up to 7deg (4deg on tiles wider than 420px), scale .985, 90ms while pressed

motion.name: tile-flip
motion.purpose: Signature move 2, only when real data replaces real data. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

userPinnedExceptions: Per-module door tints and coloured icon chips (dashboard-cards.js, legibleAccent).

components.name: Greeting
components.description: Giant light lowercase greeting, hard-clipped by its container; USER-PINNED accent username.
components.css: .ds-greet { margin: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; overflow: clip; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: clip; text-transform: lowercase; color: #f7f1f6; font-family: 'Albert Sans', 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 8rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: .92; } .ds-greet span { color: #f0a8c8; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: The day as a wall of flat, square-shouldered tinted-glass tiles over the owner's own background: Metro grammar in the incumbent glass material. One hairline edge, no sheen. Giant light lowercase type, data-first live tiles, uniform doors. The owner's theme controls drive the palette at runtime, so every colour is a default and the glass stays dark. Motion is limited to press-tilt and data-change flip, both off under reduced motion, with no entrance stagger.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tinted glass, 1px hairline, 6px tiles, 4px inner radii
Live tiles: next class (floods primary when now or later today), absences, today
Door tiles for ePortal modules and shortcuts, per-module tint (user-pinned)
Albert Sans Light with system CJK fallbacks, tabular numerals

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The theme primary alone marks live state: now, today, focused, connected.

rules.name: The User-Pinned Tint Exceptions
rules.body: Per-module door tints and coloured icon chips (dashboard-cards.js, legibleAccent), the accent-coloured greeting username, and the accent-filled settings button are deliberate. The owner pinned the tinted-glass theme; do not 'fix' them.

rules.name: The Quiet Identity Rule
rules.body: Course tints (12%/20%) and absence status dots identify; they never signal state or reach flood strength.

rules.name: The Light Giant Rule
rules.body: Size carries hierarchy; display through title stay at weight 200–300.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, date, count and range uses tabular numerals; ranges use an en dash.

rules.name: The Clip, Don't Shrink Rule
rules.body: The greeting is hard-clipped by its container, never scaled or wrapped to fit.

rules.name: The No-Sheen Rule
rules.body: One tint, one 1px edge; no inner highlight, bevel, sheen pseudo-element or pane shadow.

dos: Do read every colour from the theme variables so the owner's theme controls drive the page.
Do reserve flood strength for now and later-today only.
Do pass palette tints through legibleAccent.
Do keep press-tilt and data-change flip as the only dashboard motion, both disabled under reduced motion.
Do write UI chrome in zh-Hant. Every failure state gets a named error, recovery copy, collapsed raw detail, and the actions 重試 and 回到首頁.
Do keep phone schedule columns at least 104px, with a sticky opaque period column and auto-scroll to today.
donts: Don't 'fix' the user-pinned door tints, icon chips, accent username or accent settings button.
Don't use side stripes or nested cards in the absence list.
Don't add page-load entrance staggers to the dashboard wall.
Don't add sheen, bevels, inner highlights or drop shadows to panes.
Don't shrink or wrap the greeting.
Don't put tracked uppercase eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't let any non-primary hue mark today, now, focus or connected.
